text:
mira: Heads-up: planning a large-scale traffic replay + ramp profiling next Tue 03:00 UTC. Goal: validate steady 100k rps with 300k spike bursts, verify heap growth, disk IOPS, and network egress. Need quick checks: iostat, perf, flamegraphs, and KV cache warmup plan.

sam: Sounds good. Can you confirm exact load shape and target endpoints?

mira: load shape: 10m ramp to 100k, hold 20m, 5m spike to 300k, then cool down. Primary targets: /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings across canary model pool.

alex: I'll add perf counters on the runtime nodes. Plan to capture: cpu, rss, heap alloc, page faults, and go prof. Will also run async pprof at intervals.

jen: Do we want dedicated replay clusters? I'd prefer isolating the run from prod to avoid noisy neighbor issues. Also add a 10m pre-warm to populate KV caches.

mira: yes dedicated cluster. pre-warm = 10m prefix replay hitting same model versions. I'll post the pre-warm script shortly.

carlos: I opened a config PR to add test instance types + iops-optimized disks: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321 — needs review before we can schedule infra changes.

sam: pinging @carlos for the PR review. Also need to ensure loadgen secrets (api key) are rotated after test.

runtime-oncall: On-call note: we can run a low-volume canary in us-west-2 a few hours beforehand. I'll be on standby. Add runbook steps for rollback and node drains.

mira: runbook entries (draft):
1) Abort traffic: stop replay job in controller.
2) Fallback: route traffic to smaller-capacity model variant (v1-small).
3) If node OOM, drain and reprovision with iops-optimized disk.

alex: quick commands to collect disk IO and top info during the run:
```bash
sudo apt-get install -y sysstat perf
iostat -x 1 > /tmp/iostat.log &
vmstat 1 > /tmp/vmstat.log &
ps aux --sort=-rss | head -n 20 > /tmp/top-rss.txt
```

jen: For k6 replay we should use multiple orchestrators. Example k6 run command I'm testing:
```bash
k6 run --vus 2000 --duration 30m --out influxdb=http://influx:8086/rw tests/replay/script.js
```
I'll convert that to a distributed run once infra is green.

mira: Also planning a Locust-based heavy spike test for TTL/connection churn checks. Locust will hit long-poll websocket endpoints.

carlos: infra PR updated with mount options for nvme io optimized. Waiting on approval from infra-owners.

deploy-bot: scheduled k6 job "ramp-profiling-2026-04-21" by mira for 2026-04-21T03:00:00Z :calendar: 

sam: quick ask — can someone add a Grafana dashboard link with token-level latency + iops panels? We should track p50/p95/p99, backend queue length, and disk await.

sre-bot: dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd123/runtime-ramp-tests — added panels for p50/p95/p99, disk iops, network egress, and kv-cache hit rate.

mira: thanks. Final checklist before run: PR merged (carlos), infra green (jen), perf probes enabled (alex), dashboard pinned (sam), on-call ack (runtime-oncall). Reply with :thumbsup: if you can own your item.

sam: :thumbsup: — I'll do dashboard validation.

alex: :thumbsup: — will enable profilers and confirm retention.

jen: :thumbsup: — infra scheduling and dedicated cluster.

carlos: :thumbsup: — will chase PR review.

runtime-oncall: :thumbsup: — standby and will run canary.

mira: Great. If anyone finds a blocker, drop it here. Otherwise I'll lock the schedule 24h before run.

sre-bot: note: please ensure test keys are set to expire in 1 hour after test completion to avoid accidental use.

mira: noted — will rotate keys via secrets-manager post-run.

sam: quick Q: Should we capture flamegraphs every 5 minutes or on spike boundaries?

alex: capture at 1m intervals during spike, 5m otherwise. That should give good resolution.

mira: perfect. thanks all!
